description: Internal transfers produce NO transaction hash because no transaction occurs — this append-only journal is their only record. Never truncated; page with `before` (a seq number). Use this when a user asks to verify or dispute an internal payment, since there is no chain to check.

before.description: return entries with seq below this, for paging
